input.summary: Symmetrical successor carve-out for Customer, mutual written notice, and narrowing of M&I's consent-free route to a true successor by merger or sale of all or substantially all assets.
input.comment: [Playbook] We broadened Customer's consent-free carve-out to any successor by merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets (removing the $100,000,000 acquirer test), added a mutual written-notice requirement, and narrowed M&I's free-assignment proviso to a successor by merger or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, stock or securities so that a corporate reorganization or a sale of the M&I Data Services division alone no longer escapes the consent gate. This puts the clause at our fallback position: successor assignments on written notice, all other assignments by consent not unreasonably withheld.

ops.oldText: (a) M&I's consent need not be obtained in connection with the assignment of this Agreement pursuant to a merger in which Customer is a party and as a result of which the surviving corporation becomes an Affiliate of another bank holding company, bank, savings and loan association or other financial institution having a capital and surplus of at least $100,000,000 so long as the provisions of Section 21.11 are complied with
ops.newText: (a) M&I's consent need not be obtained in connection with the assignment of this Agreement to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of Customer's assets, so long as the provisions of Section 21.11 are complied with

ops.oldText: (b) M&I may freely assign this Agreement (i) in connection with a merger, corporate reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, stock or securities, or (ii) to any entity which is a successor to the assets or the business of the M&I Data Services division of M&I.
ops.newText: (b) M&I may freely assign this Agreement to a successor in connection with a merger or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, stock or securities.

ops.text: The assigning party shall give the other party written notice of any assignment made under clause (a) or (b) above.
